catalogue.source: docs/evidence/gf-agent/t1c/result.json: catalogue and catalogueTargetMeanings, not repeated here
catalogue.how: tsx import of the two contracts modules at the baseline, compared field by field with the T1c record
readForThisRound: building.footprint allows copy only; the catalogue has no operation that parses well-known text
the dry run of a footprint needs a reader-supplied source CRS, then a polygon object with closed rings
building.heightM is a length: unit_convert with source unit ft converts feet (international foot) to metres
unit_convert is valid only when the profiled column declares the same unit
building.storeyCount is a count: copy without a declared unit is read as a count

decisionRule: 1 positive only when definition, masked samples and a catalogue target of that exact meaning agree
2 defined but no catalogue target: unknown
3 no dictionary row, or a row that only restates the header: label only if unmistakable, at most 0.6
5 a point, centroid or parcel boundary is not a building footprint
6a lead decision: a foreign assessor's or tax parcel identifier stays unknown
6b lead decision: a system row id is a source key only if the definition says it identifies the building
6c lead decision: a height needs metres stated, or another stated unit that the catalogue converts

confidenceBins.edges: left-closed fifths; the last bin includes 1.0
confidenceBins.note: the header-only positive sits at the 0.6 cap set by rule 3, not at a free estimate

nearFitFormat: profile id: family, target considered, reason code (see nearFitReasons)

nearFitReasons.feature_id: A feature id; the row does not say it identifies the building in the publisher's records.
nearFitReasons.building_area: Area of the whole building, not a unit's built-up area; no building-area target.
nearFitReasons.ground_elev: Ground elevation above sea level at the building, not the lower elevation of a level.
nearFitReasons.roof_elev: Rooftop elevation above sea level, not the building's height, which has its own column.
nearFitReasons.type_class: A type classification, not a stated use; every profiled cell is blank.
nearFitReasons.system_id: A system object id or global id with no definition (lead decision on system row ids).
nearFitReasons.parcel_pin: The header suggests a parcel identification number; undefined, and a foreign parcel id anyway.
nearFitReasons.record_flag: An undefined record flag with one value, not the status of a document.
nearFitReasons.shape_area: System-computed area of the shape, unit not stated; not a source-stated unit or parcel area.
nearFitReasons.constant_id: The header ends in _ID, but every profiled cell holds the same value; it identifies nothing.
nearFitReasons.constant_area: The header says area, with no unit; every profiled cell holds the same value.

expectedVerifierRefusals.basis: read from the code named in readFrom; the verifier was not run
whyNoPlanRejection: Every operation is allowed for its target, and a positive target appears once per table.
The one unit_convert names ft, the unit its column profile declares (else MAPPING_UNIT_NOT_DECLARED).
A plan-level code would reject the whole table; for East Baton Rouge that is 10 lines.
whyUnverified: The line is accepted into its table plan; the dry run then returns needs_input on every filled cell.
The example is therefore written with verified false: the issue rate is above the 0.1 limit.
First code, MAPPING_CRS_UNVERIFIED: neither the profile nor the dictionary states a source CRS.
The verifier takes a CRS only from a recorded source reference, and the label assumes none.
Second code if a CRS is supplied, MAPPING_GEOMETRY_UNPARSEABLE: the cells are well-known text.
The executor accepts a polygon object; the catalogue has no operation that parses well-known text.

fieldsExpectedVerified.building.storeyCount copy: whole numbers; the blank share is below the 0.1 limit
fieldsExpectedVerified.building.heightM unit_convert ft: plain numbers with the declared unit; factor from the code-owned table
